description: Proves the drafted recipe with a full zkTLS proof through the attestor SDK. Call it after `replay_request` looks right; attestor calls are expensive. It signs with the configured proof-owner key and creates a local test key in the project `.env` when none exists; then the result has `ownerKey` with a `note`: tell the developer once, after the fact. Do not ask for a key first. Writes the full claim to `~/.reclaim/claims/<timestamp>.json`. Returns `identifier`, `extractedParameters`, `claimPath`, and a readable `claim` (request removed, byte arrays as base64). Set `RECLAIM_AGENT_TRACE=1` to also get `runLogPath`, a diagnostic dump with the attestor log stream. Set `attestorUrl` only if the developer supplied one; never invent backup URLs. If `errorKind` is `missing-owner-key`, the `ownerAddress` you passed has no known private key: retry without `ownerAddress`. Unlike `replay_request`, which re-sends from inside the attached browser tab, the attestor calls the target from its own network and IP. A request that replayed can still fail here for geo- or IP-bound content, such as country-locked pages or IP-allowlisted APIs. That is a property of the site, not a draft bug. The request goes out from `egress.geoLocation` in the result: the `geoLocation` argument, else the draft's fixed country, else your own IP country. After a network-like failure ("connection closed", `ERROR_NETWORK_ERROR`, timeout), the result includes `diagnosis` with `attestor` (a `check_attestor` result), `likelyCause`, and `next`. Follow `next`; do not retry the same proof. When the attestor gets HTTP 403/406/429/503 or a challenge page, `diagnosis` has `kind: "blocked-non-browser-client"`: the site blocks non-browser clients or traffic from that country, and copying headers or cookies will not help. Follow its `next`. Run `check_matchers` first to rule out the recipe offline.

geoLocation.description: ISO country the attestor's request goes out from, for example `US`. Omit it to use the draft's fixed country, or else your own IP country, as `{{DYNAMIC_GEO}}` resolves for you when you verify.

ownerAddress.description: Optional ETH address the resolved signing key must match. Omit it: run_proof resolves (or creates) the key itself. The private key is resolved locally (env / .env / key file), never passed here.

name: run_proof
